label: Freshman Year
description: Welcome to high school! This year you'll take honors-level classes in every subject to build the skills you'll need once college credit starts next year.

label: Sophomore Year
description: This is the year you start earning real college credit alongside your regular high school classes — it's the beginning of your path toward an associate degree.

label: Junior Year
description: Most of your classes now count for college credit too. You're doing double duty: high school diploma and college degree, at the same time.

label: Senior Year
description: Your final year! Finish strong and walk away with your high school diploma and a big head start on a college degree.
